## The Swing That Repriced the Company

SK hynix's reported numbers did not describe an ordinary rebound. Fiscal 2023 closed with KRW 32.7657 trillion of revenue and a KRW 7.7303 trillion operating loss. Fiscal 2024 then produced KRW 66.1930 trillion of revenue and KRW 23.4673 trillion of operating profit, before fiscal 2025 extended the recovery to KRW 97.1467 trillion of revenue and KRW 47.2063 trillion of operating profit. The step from 2023 to 2024 was therefore not a rounding error of the cycle; it was a KRW 31.2 trillion operating swing followed by a second record year. [SK hynix IR Financial Information](https://www.skhynix.com/eng/ir/financial-information) [SK hynix Announces 4Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-4q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/)

| Fiscal Year | Revenue (KRW T) | Operating Profit/(Loss) (KRW T) |
|---|---|---|
| 2019 | 26.99 | — |
| 2020 | 31.90 | — |
| 2021 | 42.99 | — |
| 2022 | 44.62 | 6.81 |
| 2023 | 32.77 | (7.73) |
| 2024 | 66.19 | 23.47 |
| 2025 | 97.15 | 47.21 |

The company's own explanation for that repricing was mix. In the fourth quarter of 2024, SK hynix said HBM had risen to more than 40 per cent of total DRAM revenue. For full-year 2025 it said HBM revenue had more than doubled year on year. In the first quarter of 2026 it again attributed record performance to HBM, high-capacity server DRAM modules and eSSDs. [SK hynix Announces 4Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-4q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/)

## Quarterly Progression

The recovery was visible quarter by quarter. SK hynix returned to quarterly operating profit in 4Q23 with KRW 11.306 trillion of revenue and KRW 346 billion of operating profit. Q1 2024 then rose to KRW 12.43 trillion of revenue and KRW 2.886 trillion of operating profit, Q2 2024 to KRW 16.4233 trillion and KRW 5.4685 trillion, and Q3 2024 to KRW 17.5731 trillion and KRW 7.03 trillion before Q4 2024 finished at KRW 19.7670 trillion of revenue and KRW 8.0828 trillion of operating profit. [SK hynix Reports Financial Results for 2023, 4Q23](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-reports-fourth-quarter-2023-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-1q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 2Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-2q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 3Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-3q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 4Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-4q24-financial-results/)

That progression mattered because it showed the trough had already ended before 2024 opened. The company itself said the first quarterly profit in a year arrived in 4Q23 as DDR5 and HBM3 sales rose sharply and memory prices began to stabilise. What 2024 added was scale. By the third quarter of 2024, HBM's share of DRAM revenue had reached 30 per cent and was expected to reach 40 per cent in the fourth quarter; by the full year, the group had achieved its best-ever annual result. [SK hynix Reports Financial Results for 2023, 4Q23](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-reports-fourth-quarter-2023-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 3Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-3q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 4Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-4q24-financial-results/)

## Balance Sheet and Capital Allocation

In January 2025, SK hynix raised its annual fixed dividend by 25 per cent to 1,500 won a share from 1,200 won and lifted the annual cash-dividend pool to KRW 1 trillion, while saying it would keep making flexible investment decisions under a profitability-first framework. A year later, the company declared an additional KRW 1 trillion dividend for FY2025, bringing total FY2025 dividends to KRW 2.1 trillion, or 3,000 won a share, and it said it would cancel 15.3 million treasury shares, equivalent to about 2.1 per cent of shares outstanding. [SK hynix Announces 4Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-4q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/)

The balance sheet also improved markedly by the frozen window. In 1Q26, SK hynix said cash and cash equivalents had risen to KRW 54.3 trillion while interest-bearing debt had fallen to KRW 19.3 trillion, leaving the group with net cash of KRW 35 trillion. That financial position gave the company room to lift investment again. It said 2026 spending would increase significantly year on year, focused on the ramp of M15X, infrastructure preparation at the Yongin cluster and the securing of key EUV equipment. [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/)

## The Solidigm Overlay

The NAND flank remained part of the financial story, but the chronology needed correction. The Intel NAND and SSD acquisition was a US$9 billion two-stage transaction: phase one closed on 29 December 2021 for US$7 billion, while Intel's March 2025 quarter-end filing said the second phase closed on 27 March 2025 and yielded roughly US$1.9 billion of proceeds, net of certain adjustments. By the frozen date, the deal was therefore no longer a future catalyst; it was a completed source of capital structure complexity that had already moved into integration. [SK hynix completes the First Phase of Intel NAND and SSD Business Acquisition](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-completes-the-first-phase-of-intel-nand-and-ssd-business-acquisition/) [Intel Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 29, 2025](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000074/intc-20250329.htm)

## What the Numbers Actually Said

SK hynix did not disclose HBM average selling prices or a capex-by-product breakdown, and it did not describe the Indiana project as a DRAM fab. What it did say was enough: HBM had become the decisive profit engine; eSSD demand was improving alongside AI-server deployment; dividends and treasury-share retirement had resumed from a position of restored financial strength; and future investment would concentrate on M15X, Yongin, Cheongju and Indiana packaging, and EUV-linked capacity rather than on indiscriminate commodity expansion. [SK hynix Announces 4Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-4q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/) [SK hynix Signs Investment Agreement of Advanced Chip Packaging with Indiana](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-signs-investment-agreement-of-advanced-chip-packaging-with-indiana/)

chapters.title: From the 2023 trough to the 2024 record
chapters.body:
## The Trough Ended in 4Q23

SK hynix's own reporting showed the inflection came in 4Q23. The company posted KRW 11.306 trillion of revenue and KRW 346 billion of operating profit, its first quarterly profit in a year, and said DDR5 and HBM3 sales had risen by more than four and five times year on year respectively. [SK hynix Reports Financial Results for 2023, 4Q23](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-reports-fourth-quarter-2023-financial-results/)

That mattered because it showed the company's 2024 story was not merely one of escaping the bottom. It was the story of the recovery becoming scalable.

## 2024: Profitability at Industrial Scale

Q1 2024 reported KRW 12.43 trillion of revenue and KRW 2.886 trillion of operating profit. Q2 advanced to KRW 16.4233 trillion and KRW 5.4685 trillion, with borrowings down by KRW 4.3 trillion in a quarter. Q3 rose again to KRW 17.5731 trillion and KRW 7.03 trillion, when the company said HBM had reached 30 per cent of DRAM revenue and would likely reach 40 per cent in Q4. Q4 finished at KRW 19.7670 trillion of revenue and KRW 8.0828 trillion of operating profit, capping a fiscal year in which revenue reached KRW 66.1930 trillion and operating profit KRW 23.4673 trillion. [SK hynix Announces 1Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-1q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 2Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-2q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 3Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-3q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 4Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-4q24-financial-results/)

The product sequence inside those numbers was equally clear. The history page recorded mass production of HBM3E in March 2024, and in September 2024 the company announced volume production of the world's first 12-layer HBM3E with 36GB capacity. By the end of the year, HBM had become the factor that most visibly separated SK hynix from the old commodity memory cycle. [SK hynix History](https://www.skhynix.com/company/UI-FR-CP05) [SK hynix Begins Volume Production of the World’s First 12-Layer HBM3E](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-begins-volume-production-of-the-world-first-12-layer-hbm3e/)

## 2025: Recovery Became a Franchise Claim

Fiscal 2025 changed the framing again. SK hynix reported KRW 97.1467 trillion of revenue and KRW 47.2063 trillion of operating profit, both record highs, and said HBM revenue had more than doubled year on year. This was no longer a business merely benefiting from firmer memory pricing. It was a business asserting that AI memory had become the centre of the earnings architecture. [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/)

The evidence for that claim was not limited to the income statement. During 2025, the company shipped 12-layer HBM4 samples to major customers, completed HBM4 development and prepared mass production, and then said in its FY2025 results that large-scale HBM4 production was already under way. The next product cycle was therefore arriving before the previous one had cooled. [SK hynix Ships World’s First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples to Customers](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-ships-world-first-12-layer-hbm4-samples-to-customers/) [SK hynix Completes World’s First HBM4 Development and Readies Mass Production](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-completes-worlds-first-hbm4-development-and-readies-mass-production/) [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/)

## 1Q26: The Recovery Reached the Balance Sheet

The first quarter of 2026 produced the strongest single quarter in the official record: KRW 52.5763 trillion of revenue, KRW 37.6103 trillion of operating profit and a 72 per cent operating margin. SK hynix said the result came despite normal seasonal weakness because demand for AI infrastructure remained strong and because HBM, high-capacity server DRAM modules and eSSDs kept growing. Cash and cash equivalents rose to KRW 54.3 trillion and net cash to KRW 35 trillion. [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/)

The cycle bottomed in late 2023, scaled rapidly through 2024, reset higher again in 2025, and entered 2026 with both record profitability and a materially stronger balance sheet.

chapters.title: Kwak, Park, Crooke, and the SK Group governance frame
chapters.body:
## The CEO Timeline

A March 2022 anniversary release identified Park Jung-ho as vice chairman and co-chief executive and Kwak Noh-Jung as president and co-chief executive, while the current CEO page gave Kwak a first appointment date of March 2022 and showed him remaining president and chief executive through the frozen window. [On the 10th Anniversary of SK hynix Launch, Vice Chairman Park Pledges to Build Next 100 Years Together](https://news.skhynix.com/on-the-10th-anniversary-of-sk-hynix-launch-vice-chairman-park-pledges-to-build-next-100-years-together/) [SK hynix CEO](https://www.skhynix.com/company/UI-FR-CP0301/)

That correction mattered because it changed the chronology of accountability. The executive who presided over the 2023 trough, the 2024 recovery and the early HBM4 transition was not a chief executive newly installed in 2024. It was Kwak, already in place from March 2022, first alongside Park and later as the clear face of the company's operating record. [SK hynix CEO](https://www.skhynix.com/company/UI-FR-CP0301/) [SK hynix Board of Directors](https://www.skhynix.com/sustainability/UI-FR-SA1502/)

## Kwak Noh-Jung: Manufacturing Career and Technical Training

Kwak joined Hyundai Electronics in 1994. His official education entry was a Ph.D. in materials engineering from Korea University. His listed career path ran through manufacturing and technology roles: head of D&T Technology Group in 2015, head of technology for the Cheongju fab in 2017, head of manufacturing and technology in 2019, head of manufacturing technology in 2021, president of manufacturing technology in January 2022, and chief executive from March 2022. [SK hynix CEO](https://www.skhynix.com/company/UI-FR-CP0301/) [SK hynix Board of Directors](https://www.skhynix.com/sustainability/UI-FR-SA1502/)

That was exactly the profile the HBM cycle rewarded. By the frozen window, the company's own disclosures showed the strategic centre of gravity in capacity, yield and product timing: mass production of 12-layer HBM3E in September 2024, shipment of 12-layer HBM4 samples in March 2025, completion of HBM4 development in September 2025 and a 2026 investment plan focused on M15X, Yongin and EUV. The institutional logic was clear. SK hynix's lead depended less on broad conglomerate narrative than on execution in packaging, process and supply. [SK hynix Begins Volume Production of the World’s First 12-Layer HBM3E](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-begins-volume-production-of-the-world-first-12-layer-hbm3e/) [SK hynix Ships World’s First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples to Customers](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-ships-world-first-12-layer-hbm4-samples-to-customers/) [SK hynix Completes World’s First HBM4 Development and Readies Mass Production](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-completes-worlds-first-hbm4-development-and-readies-mass-production/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/)

## Park Jung-ho's Role in the Record

Park did remain a meaningful part of the historical story. The March 2022 anniversary release showed him as vice chairman and co-chief executive during the first year of the SK hynix reorganisation under Kwak. By the frozen window's governance materials, however, Park no longer appeared among the company's current directors. The primary-source record therefore supported a narrower conclusion: Park helped frame the early post-SK Square, post-Solidigm period, but the current board and executive record by 2026 had moved on. [On the 10th Anniversary of SK hynix Launch, Vice Chairman Park Pledges to Build Next 100 Years Together](https://news.skhynix.com/on-the-10th-anniversary-of-sk-hynix-launch-vice-chairman-park-pledges-to-build-next-100-years-together/) [SK hynix Board of Directors](https://www.skhynix.com/sustainability/UI-FR-SA1502/)

## The Operating Layer That Could Actually Be Verified

The safer way to describe the operating bench was to use the titles the company itself published. Justin Kim appeared in the March 2025 HBM4-sample release as president and head of AI Infra, and the company used him as the executive voice for its claim that years of HBM production experience had positioned it for the next cycle. Kim Woohyun appeared throughout the 2024–2026 earnings releases as chief financial officer. Song Hyun Jong appeared in the FY2025 results as president and head of Corporate Center, carrying the formal line on balancing investment, financial stability and shareholder returns. [SK hynix Ships World’s First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples to Customers](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-ships-world-first-12-layer-hbm4-samples-to-customers/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-1q25-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/)

The board record added one more technically important figure. The governance page listed Cha Seon-Yong as an inside director from March 2026 and described him as president and head of the Future Technology Research Institute, with a background in DRAM technology development and a Ph.D. in electrical and electronic engineering from KAIST. That made the revised board less a generic chaebol oversight slate than a combination of manufacturing leadership, group representation and technical supervision. [SK hynix Board of Directors](https://www.skhynix.com/sustainability/UI-FR-SA1502/)

## Solidigm and the Crooke Timeline

Rob Crooke did lead Solidigm at launch in late 2021, but Solidigm itself announced in October 2022 that Crooke had departed and that Noh-Jung Kwak had become interim chief executive. By the period around the frozen window, Solidigm's leadership page listed Xin Guo and Richard Chin as the chief executives presented to customers and partners. The right historical reading was therefore that Crooke mattered to the launch, not that he still served as the ongoing bridge figure in 2026. [Senior Leadership Change](https://news.solidigm.com/en-WW/219300-senior-leadership-change) [Our Team](https://www.solidigm.com/us/en/our-team.html)

## The Governance Frame by the Frozen Window

The current board page, in a March 2026 version of the governance materials, showed a materially different structure from the earlier co-CEO period. Kwak and Cha Seon-Yong were listed as inside directors. Jang Yong-Ho of SK Inc. and Kim Jung-Kyu of SK Square were listed as other non-executive directors. Ko Seung-Beom, a former chairman of Korea's Financial Services Commission, was listed as chairman of the board, alongside independent directors Jeong Deog-Kyoon, Kim Zeong-Won, Yang Dong-Hoon, Sohn Hyun-Chul and Choi Gang-Guk. The page therefore showed a board anchored by an independent chair rather than by the SK Group chairman personally. [SK hynix Board of Directors](https://www.skhynix.com/sustainability/UI-FR-SA1502/) [SK hynix Ownership Structure](https://www.skhynix.com/ir/UI-FR-IR04/)

That did not eliminate the chaebol frame. The ownership page still showed SK Square as the largest shareholder with 146,118,388 shares, or 20.5 per cent, as of 7 April 2026. By the frozen window, the defensible description was a technically led operating company controlled through SK Square, supervised by an independent-chair board, and staffed by executives whose public mandates mapped directly to AI memory, finance and long-cycle technology development. [SK hynix Ownership Structure](https://www.skhynix.com/ir/UI-FR-IR04/) [SK hynix Board of Directors](https://www.skhynix.com/sustainability/UI-FR-SA1502/)

chapters.title: NVIDIA, hyperscalers, mobile OEMs, and the equipment supply chain
chapters.body:
## NVIDIA Was the Only Customer Relationship Publicly Visible at Product Level

No commercial relationship was more clearly documented in the public record than the one around NVIDIA's AI platform cadence. SK hynix's own HBM releases described HBM3E and HBM4 in terms that matched NVIDIA-generation deployment schedules, and the company displayed its 36GB 12-layer HBM3E alongside NVIDIA's GB200 module at COMPUTEX 2025. When it discussed HBM4, it spoke of supplying major customers and cited the need to respond smoothly to customer certification and mass-production schedules. [SK hynix Begins Volume Production of the World’s First 12-Layer HBM3E](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-begins-volume-production-of-the-world-first-12-layer-hbm3e/) [SK hynix Ships World’s First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples to Customers](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-ships-world-first-12-layer-hbm4-samples-to-customers/) [SK hynix Showcases HBM4 & Next-Gen AI Memory at COMPUTEX Taipei 2025](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-showcases-hbm4-next-gen-ai-memory-at-computex-taipei-2025/)

That did not amount to a full customer ledger, but it was enough to establish the central point: SK hynix's HBM franchise was being built in direct alignment with the leading AI-accelerator roadmap.

## Beyond NVIDIA, the Company Chose Category Over Naming

SK hynix's own filings and releases before the frozen date did not provide a primary-source list of all hyperscaler, smartphone or automotive buyers. Instead, the company referred more generally to global big-tech investment in AI servers, high-capacity server modules, eSSDs, mobile products and conventional DRAM demand. The most defensible description is therefore that NVIDIA was the named flagship relationship, while the rest of the book was disclosed by category rather than by customer name. [SK hynix Announces 4Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-4q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/)

That is not the same as saying the other demand did not exist. It is saying the company deliberately did not break it out in public at a customer-by-customer level.

## Server, Mobile and Graphics Demand

The primary-source evidence still allowed a more specific description of end-market mix. In 2024 and 2025 SK hynix repeatedly highlighted high-capacity server DRAM modules, DDR5 products and eSSD demand tied to AI servers. In 2026 it added LPDDR6 and 192GB SOCAMM2 as explicit conventional-memory growth lines. On the graphics side, it introduced GDDR7 in July 2024 and framed the product as relevant to AI, graphics and high-performance computing. [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/) [SK hynix Enhances Leadership in Graphics Memory With Introduction of Industry’s Best GDDR7](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-enhances-leadership-in-graphics-memory-with-introduction-of-industry-best-gddr7/)

For mobile, the official record was again more category-based than customer-specific. The LPDDR6 launch described the product as aimed at smartphones and tablets equipped with on-device AI, while CES and MWC 2026 materials presented LPDDR6 as part of the AI-device portfolio. That was enough to support a statement about mobile and edge-AI exposure without inventing a list of handset OEM allocations. [SK hynix Develops 1c LPDDR6, 6th-Generation 10nm-Class DRAM](https://news.skhynix.com/1c-lpddr6-development-2026/) [SK hynix Showcases Next-Generation AI Memory Innovations at CES 2026](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-showcases-next-generation-ai-memory-innovations-at-ces-2026/) [MWC 2026](https://news.skhynix.com/mwc-2026/)

## Solidigm and the Data-Centre Storage Flank

The storage side of the supply chain was easier to describe after correcting the chronology. Solidigm had already been fully acquired by the frozen date, and SK hynix's 2024–2026 releases repeatedly paired eSSD demand with AI infrastructure. The company did not publicly name every enterprise-storage customer, but it did make clear that high-capacity eSSD had become part of the AI build-out narrative rather than a disconnected legacy storage business. [SK hynix completes the First Phase of Intel NAND and SSD Business Acquisition](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-completes-the-first-phase-of-intel-nand-and-ssd-business-acquisition/) [SK hynix Announces 2Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-2q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/)

## The Supply Chain Was Becoming More Explicitly Bi-Regional

The manufacturing and packaging chain was also shifting in a way that mattered strategically. SK hynix's FY2025 and 1Q26 releases showed the group prioritising M15X in Cheongju, the first fab in Yongin, advanced packaging in Cheongju and Indiana, and EUV-related equipment. The Indiana project was explicitly described as an advanced-packaging fabrication and R&D facility for AI products, not as a memory wafer fab. [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/) [SK hynix Signs Investment Agreement of Advanced Chip Packaging with Indiana](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-signs-investment-agreement-of-advanced-chip-packaging-with-indiana/)

That meant the supply chain by the frozen window was becoming more explicitly bi-regional: front-end memory expansion remained anchored in Korea, while a meaningful part of the future back-end AI packaging chain was being built in the United States.

## Disclosure Limits by Customer

Public materials before 23 May 2026 did not allow a defensible company-by-company list of SK hynix's hyperscaler, smartphone, automotive or enterprise-SSD customers beyond the widely documented NVIDIA relationship and the broader category descriptions used by the company itself. The demand stack could be described with confidence, but unsupported named allocations could not.

chapters.title: Samsung, Micron, Kioxia, and the HBM share war
chapters.body:
## Competition Worked on Two Different Levels

The competitive picture operated on two different levels. In conventional DRAM and NAND, SK hynix still operated inside crowded global categories where Samsung Electronics, Micron, Kioxia and Western Digital/SanDisk remained the obvious reference points. In AI memory, however, the contest had become far more specific: who could develop, qualify and ship HBM at scale, on time and at high enough yields to meet the product calendars of the largest accelerator platforms.

SK hynix itself did not publish a global share table settling that debate. What it did publish was more revealing. HBM rose above 40 per cent of DRAM revenue in the fourth quarter of 2024, HBM revenue more than doubled in 2025, and large-scale HBM4 production was already under way by the FY2025 results. Those three disclosures explained why the market had stopped evaluating the company as just another participant in the memory cycle. [SK hynix Announces 4Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-4q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/)

## The HBM Contest

On SK hynix's own telling, the HBM race was being won by sequence and execution rather than by rhetoric. The company pointed to a chain of firsts: early HBM development, HBM3 mass production, 12-layer HBM3E volume production in September 2024, 12-layer HBM4 sample shipments in March 2025 and HBM4 development completion in September 2025. By the frozen window it was presenting itself not just as a supplier of premium memory but as the industry's "AI memory leader". [SK hynix Fact Sheet](https://news.skhynix.com/corporate/fact-sheet/) [SK hynix Begins Volume Production of the World’s First 12-Layer HBM3E](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-begins-volume-production-of-the-world-first-12-layer-hbm3e/) [SK hynix Ships World’s First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples to Customers](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-ships-world-first-12-layer-hbm4-samples-to-customers/) [SK hynix Completes World’s First HBM4 Development and Readies Mass Production](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-completes-worlds-first-hbm4-development-and-readies-mass-production/)

That framing did not make competitors disappear. Samsung Electronics and Micron remained the critical peers investors had to watch in DRAM and HBM, because the profitability of the AI-memory cycle depended on how quickly the premium segment broadened from one clear leader to a fuller multi-supplier market. But the part that could actually be anchored to primary sources was SK hynix's own timing advantage, not an exact share split derived from third-party market research. [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/)

## Conventional DRAM and the Limits of the Repricing

The recovery did not suspend the conventional DRAM logic of the industry. SK hynix continued to develop server modules, LPDDR6 and GDDR7, and in 1Q26 it explicitly tied strong earnings not just to HBM but to high-capacity server DRAM modules as well. That matters because the company was still a full-line memory manufacturer, not a pure HBM foundry. Conventional DRAM volumes still influenced capacity use, equipment plans and the durability of the cost base. [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/) [SK hynix Develops 1c LPDDR6, 6th-Generation 10nm-Class DRAM](https://news.skhynix.com/1c-lpddr6-development-2026/) [SK hynix Enhances Leadership in Graphics Memory With Introduction of Industry’s Best GDDR7](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-enhances-leadership-in-graphics-memory-with-introduction-of-industry-best-gddr7/)

That is the reason the repricing still carried a limit. If HBM kept expanding as a premium share of DRAM, SK hynix could plausibly defend a structurally higher margin profile. If HBM normalised into a broader supply base more quickly than the company expected, conventional DRAM economics would again matter more.

## NAND and the "Full Stack" Counterweight

The NAND field operated under a different competitive logic. Here the relevant question was less who led the next product cycle and more whether SK hynix could use its technology portfolio and the Solidigm acquisition to make storage a meaningful second AI-linked franchise. The company helped that argument by moving from 238-layer to 321-high NAND and by repeatedly linking high-capacity eSSD demand to the AI infrastructure cycle. It even used the phrase "Full Stack AI Memory Provider" in the 321-high NAND release, making explicit that it wanted investors to read NAND and eSSD as complements to HBM rather than as a separate low-quality earnings stream. [SK hynix Develops World’s Highest 238-Layer 4D NAND Flash](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-develops-worlds-highest-238-layer-4d-nand-flash/) [SK hynix Starts Mass Production of World’s First 321-High NAND](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-starts-mass-production-of-world-first-321-high-nand/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/)

That did not erase the existence of strong NAND peers. It did mean the competitive question for SK hynix's storage line was no longer only about commodity bits. It was also about whether Solidigm and high-layer NAND could keep the company relevant in the data-centre storage budget attached to the same AI build-out that was driving HBM.

## Geography as a Competitive Variable

The production map was itself part of the competitive story. FY2025 and 1Q26 disclosures showed future investment concentrating on M15X in Cheongju, the first fab in the Yongin cluster, advanced packaging in Cheongju and Indiana, and key EUV equipment. That pointed to a strategy of defending the premium end of the market through controlled front-end and back-end expansion in Korea and the United States rather than through indiscriminate commodity volume growth. [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/) [SK hynix Signs Investment Agreement of Advanced Chip Packaging with Indiana](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-signs-investment-agreement-of-advanced-chip-packaging-with-indiana/)

## The Durable Question

SK hynix had plainly moved into a leadership position in AI memory as measured by its own product cadence, revenue mix and profitability. What remained unresolved by the frozen window was how long that leadership would retain unusually high margins once the rest of the industry closed some of the timing gap and once HBM4 moved from early supply into broader industrial scale.

chapters.title: From 2023 losses to the 2024 record and the HBM4 race
chapters.body:
## The Trough and the Turn

The trough ended in 4Q23 rather than sometime vaguely in 2024. SK hynix reported its first quarterly operating profit in a year in the fourth quarter of 2023, with KRW 11.306 trillion of revenue and KRW 346 billion of operating profit, and said DDR5 and HBM3 sales had risen by more than four and five times year on year respectively. [SK hynix Reports Financial Results for 2023, 4Q23](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-reports-fourth-quarter-2023-financial-results/)

That made 2024 the acceleration phase rather than the initial rescue. Q1 2024 produced KRW 12.43 trillion of revenue and KRW 2.886 trillion of operating profit, Q2 reached KRW 16.4233 trillion and KRW 5.4685 trillion, Q3 reached KRW 17.5731 trillion and KRW 7.03 trillion, and Q4 closed at KRW 19.7670 trillion and KRW 8.0828 trillion. By then the company was describing itself as the world's No.1 AI memory company and saying HBM's share of DRAM revenue had risen from 30 per cent in Q3 to more than 40 per cent in Q4. [SK hynix Announces 1Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-1q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 2Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-2q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 3Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-3q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 4Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-4q24-financial-results/)

## The HBM3E Milestone

The product milestone inside that profit recovery was not conjectural. SK hynix said in March 2024 that it had begun mass production of 8-layer HBM3E, and in September 2024 it said it had begun volume production of the world's first 12-layer HBM3E with 36GB capacity. By the end of 2024, the HBM programme had therefore moved from recovery aid to the centre of the company's earnings engine. [SK hynix History](https://www.skhynix.com/company/UI-FR-CP05) [SK hynix Begins Volume Production of the World’s First 12-Layer HBM3E](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-begins-volume-production-of-the-world-first-12-layer-hbm3e/)

## The 2025 Reset: From Recovery to Franchise

Fiscal 2025 added a second, different catalyst. The company reported KRW 97.1467 trillion of revenue and KRW 47.2063 trillion of operating profit for the year, said HBM revenue had more than doubled year on year, and stated that large-scale HBM4 production was already under way after preparation for mass production had been completed in September 2025. That shifted the debate from whether the company had recovered to whether it had built a multi-year franchise in premium AI memory. [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/) [SK hynix Completes World’s First HBM4 Development and Readies Mass Production](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-completes-worlds-first-hbm4-development-and-readies-mass-production/)

The HBM4 timetable itself was explicit. SK hynix shipped 12-layer HBM4 samples to major customers in March 2025 and said it would complete preparations for mass production in the second half of that year. In September it said the development work was complete and the product was ready for mass production. Those two disclosures, taken together, made HBM4 the central forward operating catalyst by the frozen window. [SK hynix Ships World’s First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples to Customers](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-ships-world-first-12-layer-hbm4-samples-to-customers/) [SK hynix Completes World’s First HBM4 Development and Readies Mass Production](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-completes-worlds-first-hbm4-development-and-readies-mass-production/)

## The Balance-Sheet Catalyst

The completed earnings rebound also restored shareholder returns while still allowing investment to rise. SK hynix raised the fixed dividend in January 2025, then declared KRW 2.1 trillion of total FY2025 dividends and a 15.3 million-share treasury cancellation in January 2026. In April 2026 it reported net cash of KRW 35 trillion and said investment would rise significantly in 2026 for M15X, Yongin and EUV. Those disclosures mattered because they showed that the HBM cycle was feeding both operating scale and balance-sheet optionality. [SK hynix Announces 4Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-4q24-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/)

## What Was No Longer a Catalyst

The Solidigm phase-two close also had to move out of the forward bucket. Intel's March 2025 quarter-end filing said the second phase closed on 27 March 2025. By the frozen window, therefore, the event no longer belonged in an "expected December 2025" frame. The remaining question was post-close execution, not transaction certainty. [Intel Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 29, 2025](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000074/intc-20250329.htm)

chapters.title: HBM TSV packaging, EUV DRAM, and the technology roadmap
chapters.body:
## HBM Packaging as the Technical Core

SK hynix's public technical narrative revolved around advanced packaging rather than abstract semiconductor prestige. Its releases repeatedly described HBM as a high-value memory created by vertically interconnecting multiple DRAM chips, and the company presented its HBM leadership as a product of manufacturing experience accumulated across several generations rather than as a single-cycle victory. [SK hynix Ships World’s First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples to Customers](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-ships-world-first-12-layer-hbm4-samples-to-customers/) [SK hynix Begins Volume Production of the World’s First 12-Layer HBM3E](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-begins-volume-production-of-the-world-first-12-layer-hbm3e/)

That framing was borne out by the sequence of releases. The company identified itself as the first to mass-produce HBM3 in 2022, then the first to mass-produce both 8-layer and 12-layer HBM3E in 2024, then the first to ship 12-layer HBM4 samples in March 2025 and to complete HBM4 development in September 2025. The underlying claim was not merely speed to announcement. It was the ability to move from development to volume supply with enough stability to satisfy major AI customers. [SK hynix Fact Sheet](https://news.skhynix.com/corporate/fact-sheet/) [SK hynix Ships World’s First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples to Customers](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-ships-world-first-12-layer-hbm4-samples-to-customers/) [SK hynix Completes World’s First HBM4 Development and Readies Mass Production](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-completes-worlds-first-hbm4-development-and-readies-mass-production/)

## HBM3E: Capacity Before HBM4

The decisive 2024 technical milestone was the 12-layer HBM3E product. In September 2024, SK hynix said it had begun volume production of the world's first 12-layer HBM3E with 36GB capacity, the largest among existing HBM products at the time. The company also said the DRAM chips had been made 40 per cent thinner, allowing a 50 per cent increase in capacity at the same thickness as the prior 8-layer product. That is the kind of physical engineering claim that turns an otherwise generic "AI memory leader" slogan into something financially legible. [SK hynix Begins Volume Production of the World’s First 12-Layer HBM3E](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-begins-volume-production-of-the-world-first-12-layer-hbm3e/)

HBM3E mattered not only as a single product but as proof that SK hynix could scale the denser stack before the HBM4 cycle began. By the end of 2024, HBM had risen above 40 per cent of DRAM revenue, which implied that the engineering milestone had already become a mix-shift milestone. [SK hynix Announces 4Q24 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-4q24-financial-results/)

## HBM4: Samples, Mass-Production Readiness, Then Scale

The HBM4 disclosures added a new set of technical markers. In March 2025, SK hynix said it had shipped the world's first 12-layer HBM4 samples to major customers ahead of schedule and that the product combined best-in-class bandwidth and capacity. It also highlighted the use of the Advanced MR-MUF process and said the sample's 36GB capacity was the highest among 12-layer HBM products. In September 2025, it said HBM4 development was complete and the product was ready for mass production. By January 2026, it said large-scale production was already under way. [SK hynix Ships World’s First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples to Customers](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-ships-world-first-12-layer-hbm4-samples-to-customers/) [SK hynix Completes World’s First HBM4 Development and Readies Mass Production](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-completes-worlds-first-hbm4-development-and-readies-mass-production/) [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/)

The company also used 2026 trade-show communications to show the next extension of that roadmap. At CES 2026 it unveiled a 16-layer HBM4 with 48GB for the first time. At COMPUTEX 2025 it described HBM4 as the industry's fastest HBM at 2 terabytes per second and presented the 12-layer HBM4 and 12-layer HBM3E together as the AI-memory bridge from the Blackwell cycle into the Rubin cycle. Those exhibition releases were not formal earnings filings, but they were still primary-source evidence of the product roadmap the company chose to show customers. [SK hynix Showcases Next-Generation AI Memory Innovations at CES 2026](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-showcases-next-generation-ai-memory-innovations-at-ces-2026/) [SK hynix Showcases HBM4 & Next-Gen AI Memory at COMPUTEX Taipei 2025](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-showcases-hbm4-next-gen-ai-memory-at-computex-taipei-2025/)

## Conventional DRAM R&D Did Not Stop

The HBM lead did not replace the conventional DRAM roadmap; it sat on top of it. In June 2025, SK hynix used the IEEE VLSI symposium to present a long-term DRAM roadmap and said it was considering a shift to a 4F² vertical-gate platform as scaling limits tightened. In March 2026, it announced the development of 1c LPDDR6 based on the sixth-generation 10nm-class process, claiming 33 per cent faster speed and more than 20 per cent better power efficiency than LPDDR5X. In 1Q26, it tied that process roadmap to volume products, saying LPDDR6 and 192GB SOCAMM2 had already entered the shipment plan. [SK hynix Presents Future DRAM Technology Roadmap at IEEE VLSI 2025](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-presents-future-dram-technology-roadmap-at-ieee-vlsi-2025/) [SK hynix Develops 1c LPDDR6, 6th-Generation 10nm-Class DRAM](https://news.skhynix.com/1c-lpddr6-development-2026/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/)

Graphics DRAM was following the same pattern. In July 2024, SK hynix introduced GDDR7 and said it would mass-produce the part in the third quarter, framing it as a next-generation graphics memory with 60 per cent higher speed and 50 per cent better power efficiency than the prior generation. That mattered because it showed the company still treating non-HBM premium DRAM as a real technology race. [SK hynix Enhances Leadership in Graphics Memory With Introduction of Industry’s Best GDDR7](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-enhances-leadership-in-graphics-memory-with-introduction-of-industry-best-gddr7/)

## NAND Innovation Stayed on the Agenda

The storage roadmap remained active alongside the DRAM and HBM push. SK hynix developed the industry's highest 238-layer 4D NAND in 2022, began mass production in 2023, and then in November 2024 announced mass production of the world's first 321-high 4D NAND with 1Tb capacity. In that release it said the "3 plugs" process technology and low-stress material development had made stacking above 300 layers commercially viable. [SK hynix Develops World’s Highest 238-Layer 4D NAND Flash](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-develops-worlds-highest-238-layer-4d-nand-flash/) [SK hynix Begins Mass Production of Industry’s Highest 238-Layer 4D NAND](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-begins-mass-production-of-industrys-highest-238-layer-4d-nand/) [SK hynix Starts Mass Production of World’s First 321-High NAND](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-starts-mass-production-of-world-first-321-high-nand/)

That sequence is important because it shows the company trying to build a "full stack" AI memory story from both directions: premium DRAM through HBM and premium storage through high-layer NAND and eSSD.

## The Technical Record by the Frozen Window

The official record supported a clear technical portrait. SK hynix was investing in three hard things at once: denser HBM packaging, next-node DRAM for AI devices and servers, and higher-layer NAND for storage tied to the same infrastructure build-out. By the frozen window, those were not promises; they were product families already being shown, shipped or ramped. [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/)

chapters.title: Memory cycle, Samsung HBM4 push, China exposure, Korean chaebol governance
chapters.body:
## Cycle Risk Never Disappeared

The headline risk remained the oldest one in memory: capacity can be built faster than demand can remain exceptional. SK hynix's own numbers showed how violent the swing could be, from a KRW 7.7303 trillion operating loss in 2023 to KRW 23.4673 trillion of operating profit in 2024 and KRW 47.2063 trillion in 2025. That speed of improvement was the investment case, but it was also the warning. If HBM lost some of its scarcity premium or if conventional DRAM pricing weakened again, margins could compress much faster than the market wanted to assume. [SK hynix IR Financial Information](https://www.skhynix.com/eng/ir/financial-information) [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/)

## HBM4 Execution Risk

The most immediate operating risk sat in execution, not in concept. SK hynix had already shipped 12-layer HBM4 samples, completed development, and said large-scale production was under way. That was a strong position to hold, but it also meant the company had moved from proving the product to proving that volume, yield and delivery could be sustained while competitors worked to narrow the timing gap. The very fact that HBM had become such a large share of DRAM revenue made the franchise more sensitive to any stumble in the next transition. [SK hynix Ships World’s First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples to Customers](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-ships-world-first-12-layer-hbm4-samples-to-customers/) [SK hynix Completes World’s First HBM4 Development and Readies Mass Production](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-completes-worlds-first-hbm4-development-and-readies-mass-production/) [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/)

## Capital-Intensity Risk

The company itself signalled that investment would rise again. FY2025 guidance pointed to M15X, the first Yongin fab, and advanced packaging in Cheongju and Indiana; 1Q26 added EUV equipment and said investment would increase significantly compared with the previous year. That spending may have been rational, but it still created the classic semiconductor risk that large fixed commitments are made ahead of realised demand. [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/) [SK hynix Signs Investment Agreement of Advanced Chip Packaging with Indiana](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-signs-investment-agreement-of-advanced-chip-packaging-with-indiana/)

## Storage and Integration Risk

The Solidigm transaction was already closed by the frozen window, but that did not eliminate storage risk. It shifted the question from deal certainty to post-close returns. SK hynix still had to demonstrate that enterprise SSD and high-layer NAND could become a durable second profit engine rather than merely a capital-intensive hedge against DRAM cyclicality. [Intel Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 29, 2025](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000074/intc-20250329.htm) [SK hynix Starts Mass Production of World’s First 321-High NAND](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-starts-mass-production-of-world-first-321-high-nand/)

## Governance and Control

The governance risk also had to be described more precisely than in the draft. The board was chaired by an independent director by the frozen window, but the ownership page still showed SK Square as the largest shareholder with 20.5 per cent of shares outstanding. That meant minority investors were dealing with a company whose public governance had matured, yet whose strategic control still sat clearly inside the SK group structure. [SK hynix Board of Directors](https://www.skhynix.com/sustainability/UI-FR-SA1502/) [SK hynix Ownership Structure](https://www.skhynix.com/ir/UI-FR-IR04/)

## Geographic and Regulatory Risk

Finally, there was the geographic question. New front-end and back-end investment was increasingly concentrated in Korea and, for advanced packaging, in Indiana. But the Intel NAND acquisition also left the company with material manufacturing exposure in China through Dalian. The official releases did not present that as an immediate crisis, yet the long-run direction of capital allocation suggested management understood that premium AI memory and packaging capacity needed to sit in jurisdictions with cleaner policy visibility. [SK hynix completes the First Phase of Intel NAND and SSD Business Acquisition](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-completes-the-first-phase-of-intel-nand-and-ssd-business-acquisition/) [SK hynix Signs Investment Agreement of Advanced Chip Packaging with Indiana](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-signs-investment-agreement-of-advanced-chip-packaging-with-indiana/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/)

chapters.title: HBM4, Solidigm phase 2, and the 2026-2027 strategic horizon
chapters.body:
## The Questions That Still Mattered by May 2026

By the frozen window, the question was not whether a newly installed chief executive could stabilise the company or whether phase two of the Intel NAND deal would close. Kwak had already been chief executive since March 2022, and Intel's own filing said the second closing had already occurred on 27 March 2025. The forward questions were narrower: how quickly HBM4 would scale, how much additional capital the company would deploy into M15X, Yongin and packaging, and whether the exceptional 2024–2026 margin structure could survive broader supply normalisation. [SK hynix CEO](https://www.skhynix.com/company/UI-FR-CP0301/) [Intel Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 29, 2025](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000074/intc-20250329.htm)

## HBM4 as the Next Earnings Engine

The official HBM4 timetable was clear enough to support a more disciplined forecast. SK hynix shipped 12-layer HBM4 samples to major customers in March 2025 and said mass production would begin in the second half of that year following certification. In September 2025 it said development was complete and the product was ready for mass production. In January 2026 it said large-scale HBM4 production was already under way to meet customer requests. At CES 2026 it also unveiled a 16-layer HBM4 with 48GB for the first time, signalling where the next specification step was heading even though the commercial ramp still centred on the 12-layer product. [SK hynix Ships World’s First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples to Customers](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-ships-world-first-12-layer-hbm4-samples-to-customers/) [SK hynix Completes World’s First HBM4 Development and Readies Mass Production](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-completes-worlds-first-hbm4-development-and-readies-mass-production/) [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/) [SK hynix Showcases Next-Generation AI Memory Innovations at CES 2026](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-showcases-next-generation-ai-memory-innovations-at-ces-2026/)

The commercial frame around that timetable was also supported by primary sources. NVIDIA's March 2025 roadmap presentation introduced the Vera CPU and Rubin GPU sequence. SK hynix's FY2025 release said customer trust had been secured by stable simultaneous supply of HBM3E and HBM4, which is as close as the company came in public filings to stating its confidence that the franchise would continue into the next platform transition. [NVIDIA Accelerated Computing Platform Roadmap](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-accelerated-computing-platform) [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/)

## Capacity Expansion: What the Company Actually Said

In FY2025 SK hynix said it would maximise production capacity at the M15X fab in Cheongju, secure mid- to long-term supply through the first fab in the Yongin Semiconductor Cluster, and continue building advanced packaging facilities in Cheongju and Indiana. In 1Q26 it said investment would increase significantly year on year, focused on the ramp of M15X, infrastructure preparation at Yongin and the securing of key EUV equipment. [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/)

Indiana was not a DRAM fab. The April 2024 release described it as an estimated US$3.87 billion advanced-packaging fabrication and R&D facility for AI products in West Lafayette, with mass production targeted for the second half of 2028. The site therefore belonged in the long-term back-end expansion plan, not in any description of near-term front-end wafer capacity. [SK hynix Signs Investment Agreement of Advanced Chip Packaging with Indiana](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-signs-investment-agreement-of-advanced-chip-packaging-with-indiana/)

## Conventional Memory and the "Full Stack" Push

The outlook was not HBM-only, even if HBM dominated earnings. In 1Q26 the company said it would fully ramp LPDDR6 built on the 1cnm process and the 192GB SOCAMM2 module that had entered mass production that month. In March 2026 it separately announced the development of 1c LPDDR6 with 33 per cent faster speed and more than 20 per cent better power efficiency than LPDDR5X. Those disclosures showed management trying to extend the AI-memory thesis into conventional DRAM categories rather than allowing the franchise to narrow to one product family. [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/) [SK hynix Develops 1c LPDDR6, 6th-Generation 10nm-Class DRAM](https://news.skhynix.com/1c-lpddr6-development-2026/)

The NAND side of the story also evolved. By 2024 the company had begun mass production of 321-high 4D NAND and described itself as being on track to become a "Full Stack AI Memory Provider" by adding ultra-high-performance NAND to the HBM-led DRAM franchise. That was not equivalent to solving all the economics of the Solidigm integration, but it did show the official strategic direction. [SK hynix Starts Mass Production of World’s First 321-High NAND](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-starts-mass-production-of-world-first-321-high-nand/)

## The Real Horizon

SK hynix entered the 2026-2027 horizon with record profitability, a net-cash position, HBM4 already in large-scale production, and explicit plans to spend more on M15X, Yongin, EUV and packaging. The unresolved part was not whether the company had an HBM franchise; the official record already established that it did. The unresolved part was whether the franchise would remain unusually profitable once HBM4 moved from shortage economics into broader industrial scale. [SK hynix Announces FY25 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/) [SK hynix Announces 1Q26 Financial Results](https://news.skhynix.com/q1-2026-business-results/)

structural_observations: The fiscal 2023 KRW 7.73T operating LOSS reflects the steepest memory cycle downturn in a decade — caused by post-COVID inventory unwind plus the AI-cycle pre-spending gap.

The fiscal 2024 KRW 23.47T operating PROFIT (a KRW 31T year-on-year swing) is the principal cyclical recovery print in SK Hynix's history and was driven substantially by the HBM premium on NVIDIA supply.

SK Hynix's HBM lead over Samsung Electronics on NVIDIA qualification is the single most consequential commercial fact in the memory industry through 2024-2025 — it reversed the historical Samsung scale advantage in DRAM.

Solidigm operates as a US-headquartered SK Hynix subsidiary in San Jose, California, with manufacturing primarily in Dalian, China. Rob Crooke (former Intel SVP and GM of the Non-Volatile Memory Solutions Group) leads Solidigm.
